reviews.title: Totally worth it!
reviews.comment: The monitors are perfect for what I need. I can play games on them easy & they are affordable. Worth every penny

reviews.title: Love it , just what I needed
reviews.comment: I love the image quality and the connection is so easy. The only thing I have that's slightly negative would be the speakers are not high quality, and its rather muffled. That would be fixed with plug in speakers
reviews.author: usermine
